hook.name: FedzHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a FUSD/USDT stablecoin pool that gates swaps and liquidity operations to NFT-holding players whose turn is active in a time-slot system. Enforces a depeg threshold (reverting swaps and removals when price falls below it) and returns a variable swap fee from beforeSwap based on a configurable crisis state.
